g.title: projectrouter final v2 desktop patch

g.text: A playable full-stack lunar logistics simulation.

with a typed Vue interface and browser-level tests.

g.title: featured yandex geocoder region parser
g.text: A geospatial pipeline that enriches district datasets

Four linked Airflow DAGs; intermediate data
in MinIO/S3 with repeatable ETL stages.
Additional backend, ML and automation work.
